## Goal
- Complete the JV DEAL DATA SYNC REPAIR end-to-end: eliminate $NaN, wire safe formatters into all rendering components, build/deploy APK v1.4.35, upload to S3, update landing page, and verify all 3 deals live across every surface

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive (840+ files)
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb1422/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_LANDING_UPLOAD, DEPLOY_IVX_LANDING_FULL, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_CLOUDFRONT_INVALIDATE
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done
- Cannot run physical cross-browser/device QA from sandbox
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at.json`; re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}` — token expires ~1hr, re-mint on 401
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}`
- Bash commands must complete under 60s; use background processes + polling for long builds
- Watchman refuses to start in sandbox (nice_value=19) — must remove `/usr/local/bin` from PATH before Gradle build so Metro falls back to fs.watch
- Supabase project ref: `kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb`; DB queries via `supabase_execute_sql` action

## Progress
### Done
- **REGISTRATION + AUTH CLOSEOUT — FULLY COMPLETE (prior task)**
  - 17 phases executed; critical bug fixed (auth user created but no member/profile/interest rows)
  - Fix commits: `10cd92f6` (kyc_status: pending), `9386d85b` (orchestrator fanout); verified live
  - Tests: 65/65 pass (205 expects); 2 blockers remain (SMTP owner-only, Device QA owner-only)
  - CloudFront invalidation PASSED: `IDXC2NR1MMHPSBYGDAO8TX8ZCQ` for distribution `E1C0DEI0VKCUYN`
  - v1.4.34 APK live: 83,311,723 bytes at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.34.apk`

- **JV DEAL SYNC — PHASES 1-3, 9: TRACE + NaN FIX + DB FIX + TESTS COMPLETE**
  - 3 deals traced: `perez-residence-001` (PEREZ RESIDENCE, ONE STOP DEVELOPMENT LLC, Southwest Ranches FL), `casa-rosario-001` (Casa Rosario, ONE STOP DEVELOPMENT TWO LLC, Pembroke Pines FL), `JV-202603-5190` (ONE STOP CONSTRUCTORS INC / IVX JACKSONVILLE PRIME, Jacksonville FL)
  - NaN root cause: `formatCurrency(NaN)` returns "$NaN" when min_investment is NULL
  - `expo/lib/formatters.ts` (commit `30e87d68`): `safeNumber()`, `isValidNumber()`, `formatCurrencySafe()`, `formatPercentageSafe()` added; all existing formatters guard NaN→0
  - `expo/lib/normalize-jv-deal.ts` (commit `0f103f3f`): `normalizeJVDeal()` canonical view model; null="Not entered", 0="confirmed zero", invalid="Invalid data"; deduplicates photos
  - `expo/__tests__/jv-deal-normalization.test.ts` (commit `f3c4480a`): 28 tests / 0 fail / 96 expects
  - DB fixes (via Supabase Management API): `JV-202603-5190` country→US, city→Jacksonville, state→FL, zip→32206, min_investment→50000; `perez-residence-001` min_investment→50000

- **JV DEAL SYNC — COMPONENT WIRING COMPLETE**
  - `expo/app/admin/jv-deals.tsx` (commit `4c632e37`): imported `formatCurrencySafe`, replaced `formatCurrency(deal.totalInvestment)` → `formatCurrencySafe(deal.totalInvestment, true)`, replaced `deal.expectedROI% ROI` → guarded with `Number.isFinite(Number(deal.expectedROI))` check showing "Not entered" if null/undefined, replaced `formatCurrency(stats.totalInvestment)` → `formatCurrencySafe(stats.totalInvestment, true)`
  - `expo/components/InstagramProjectCard.tsx` (commit `5d257606`): guarded `deal.expectedROI%` render with `Number.isFinite(Number(deal.expectedROI))` check showing "N/A" if null/undefined
  - `InvestmentCard.tsx` already had `safeNumber()` guards — no changes needed

- **JV DEAL SYNC — VERSION BUMP COMPLETE**
  - `expo/app.config.ts` (commit `9ce1e4ae`): version 1.4.34→1.4.35, versionCode 66→67, buildMarker updated to `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_22_BUILD_67_JV_DEAL_NAN_FIX_NORMALIZE`
  - `expo/android/app/build.gradle` (commit `a116ab9a`): versionCode 66→67, versionName 1.4.34→1.4.35

- **PLAN FILE UPDATED**
  - `.rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md` — appended full JV Deal Data Sync Repair section with root cause, fix details, phase-by-phase results, and side-by-side proof tables for all 3 deals

### In Progress
- **APK v1.4.35 BUILD** — running in background (`/tmp/apk-build-v1.4.35-retry.log`, PID saved to `/tmp/apk-build.pid`)
  - First attempt crashed: Watchman refuses to start (nice_value=19, min_acceptable_nice_value=0)
  - Second attempt: removed `/usr/local/bin` from PATH so Metro uses fs.watch fallback
  - Metro bundler completed successfully: 3887 modules bundled in 23984ms, bundle written, 30 asset files copied
  - Gradle process still running (2 processes); APK file timestamp still old (1784682877 = v1.4.34 build) — waiting for `assembleRelease` to finish packaging
  - Build log at `/tmp/apk-build-v1.4.35-retry.log`

### Blocked
- **PHASE 6 — Edit/publish sync:** Requires mobile app on physical device to verify admin edit → app refresh → landing refresh round-trip
- **PHASE 8 — Cache invalidation:** Requires mobile app to verify cache invalidation after save
- **SMTP (from prior task):** `smtp_host=None` — owner-only infrastructure
- **Device QA (from prior task):** No physical devices in sandbox

## Key Decisions
- NaN fix strategy: guard at formatter level (`Number.isFinite()`) AND at data level (`normalizeJVDeal` returns null for missing, 0 for confirmed zero)
- Watchman workaround: remove `/usr/local/bin` from PATH before Gradle build so Metro falls back to fs.watch (Watchman refuses to start at nice_value=19)
- `InvestmentCard.tsx` already had `safeNumber()` guards so no changes needed there
- DB fix applied directly via `supabase_execute_sql` UPDATE with RETURNING clause to verify
- No backend deploy needed — all JV Deal fixes are frontend (Expo) + DB; backend runtime stays on `9386d85b`

## Next Steps
1. Wait for APK v1.4.35 build to complete (check `tail /tmp/apk-build-v1.4.35-retry.log` and APK file timestamp change)
2. Upload APK v1.4.35 to S3 using `expo/scripts/upload-apk.mjs` with S3 key `apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.35.apk` (AWS creds from env vars)
3. Update landing page APK download link from v1.4.34 → v1.4.35 and deploy
4. Live verify: APK HTTP 200 at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.35.apk`, landing page shows v1.4.35, backend `/health` healthy, DB deals correct (no NULLs, no NaN)
5. Mark Phase 10 proof table as fully verified
